svg.text: System Suicide · Module 9 · Postapocalypse Reverberator · v6.4 + Decision 11 (plate-only cartridge, in-module transducers)
B. CARTRIDGE (passive plate) + MODULE TRANSDUCER ENGINE — contact coupling (Decision 11)
▣ amber = картридж (пассивная пластина). Остальное = module engine bay.
Spring-loaded contact coupling. НЕТ разъёмов на картридже (Decision 11).
E. FUNCTION GENERATOR (primary modulation source — analog Tides-class)
Operating modes (auto): free-run LFO (idle >5s) · external triggered · plate-triggered (signal-driven via envelope rising edge)
Controls: rise/fall/depth sliders + exp/log curve knob + speed/range knob + TAP clock sync (continuous multiplier)
Outputs: EG OUT (main wave × depth) · Gate · Sub÷2 · Inv · EOR (internally normalled → TOLL solenoid)
NOISE level · COLOR(geiger) crossfader → mix bus (post-VCA)
J. PERFORM GESTURES (footswitches mockup canon + CV-only modular advanced)
J_TOLL_TRIG — solenoid bell strike (normalled от FG EOR)
J_SIDE — sidechain in (normalled к main input)
SKU: Eurorack 40HP (±12V bus) OR big-box pedal 203×140mm (12V DC, 800mA min; +12V_RAW solenoid + isolated DC-DC audio).
Phase 1 BOM: ~$101 budget / $127 premium. Phase 2 +$38 (cold palette daughter board: PULSE/FOG/FROST/CHILL/HUM). MCU: ATtiny84A 14-pin.
Retail: $499 budget / $649 premium / $2499 Elite LE (25 serialized units per Decision 10). Pre-prod validation: SPICE Nyquist + blind A/B cartridge + Bank Mode listener test.
